description:
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior-Union
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26002411
DOCKET NO. F01007625
PLAINTIFF – NEWREZ LLC D/B/A SHELLPOINT MORTGAGE SERVICING
DEFENDANTS- JAMIE VESPREY; STATE OF NEW JERSEY; UNITED STATES OF AMERICA
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public venue on
Wednesday THE 18th DAY OF November 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Warinanco Ice Skating Center, 1 Park Drive, Roselle, New Jersey 07203 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the town of ELIZABETH, County of Union and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 25 FKA 620 BLOCK 741 FKA 5
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
65 FLORIDA STREET ELIZABETH, NJ 07206
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Union County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes: Dimensions: [OO.OFT X 25.OFT X IOO.OFT X 25.OFT
Nearest cross Street: SECOND AVENUE
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Please be advised that definitive occupancy information is not available and Plaintiff makes no representation regarding occupancy.
Good Faith Estimated Upset: $396,360.57
*Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums 01' other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether any outstanding interest remains of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
** If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee or the Mortgagee's attorney.
*** After the sate and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money * The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
**** Pursuant to 28, Section 2410(c), this sale is subject to a 120 day right of redemption held by the United States of America by virtue of The Secretary of Housing and Urban Development to Jamie Vesprey recorded in the Office of the Union County Clerk on May 22, 2023, in Book 15366, Page 2186, to secure $60,090.09.
*** *PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that this matter involves an FHA- insured mortgage loan and may be subject to applicable HUD and/or CAFMV bidding
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Union County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $364,563.46 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Peter D. Corvelli
SHERIFF
